sloka: कर्तारम् अपि लोकानाम् शूरम् करुण वेदिनम् ।अज्ञानात् अवमन्येरन् सर्व भूतानि लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-५४॥
transliteration: kartāram api lokānām śūram karuṇa vedinam ।ajñānāt avamanyeran sarva bhūtāni lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-54॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana even the compassionate and heroic Creator of the worlds will be disrespected by all beings, however ignorantly (if such things are allowed to happen).
